data.narrative:
MaverickX is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Eric Herrera and Jesse Evans that has raised $19M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers, including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. However, the private peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with similar valuation characteristics to support a reliable peer-median approach.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable triangulation lens here. Using total capital raised ($19M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.5x multiplier for progression from Seed to the next stage yields an implied valuation of $48M. This reflects standard venture capital convention for capital deployment and dilution patterns at this stage.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $40M to $55M, with a median estimate of $48M. This range carries meaningful uncertainty given the absence of narrow-set peer comparables; the single-method foundation leaves the valuation sensitive to stage-progression assumptions and the appropriateness of the 2.5x multiplier to MaverickX's specific growth trajectory and capital efficiency. Further data on similar-stage Climate & Energy companies or MaverickX-specific metrics (burn rate, customer traction, technical milestones) would strengthen conviction in this band.
